summary: Price Volume Trend: a running total of volume times the percent change in close, with an optional signal line.
overview: Price Volume Trend (PVT) is a running volume line in its own pane, like OBV but scaled by how much price moved.
It is green while rising and red while falling. An optional signal line (21 bars, SMA by default) can be shown.
how: PVT = previous PVT + volume x (close - previous close) / previous close.
Large moves add more volume than small ones, unlike OBV which adds full volume on any up close.
use: Some traders look for divergence between PVT and price.
Use the signal line to see when PVT turns.
Compare it with OBV to see the effect of move size.
Use a rising PVT in a range as a sign of accumulation.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: It needs volume data; on symbols without volume it shows nothing useful.
Its starting level has no meaning; read its slope.
